issues: before 是整张灰度 + 灰罩，像禁用截图，是自黑而不是可信的“处理前”
BEFORE/AFTER 角标是灰条占位，且不随分割线裁切，压在卡片上
分割杆 6px 实白 + 重黑晕，手柄 3px 灰边 + CSS 三角，像线框稿
快甩直接从静止弹出，无预备；手柄只做 scaleX，高速段没有速度感
changes: before 改为轻微失焦（1.6px）+ 降饱和 + 低对比 + 暖灰雾面，同布局同机位，差异可信
真文字 Before / After 胶囊放进顶栏空白处，各自长在自己那一层，随分割线一起被揭开
分割杆换 2px 白线 + 发丝描边 + 软影，after 侧 24px 接触暗影；手柄为渐变白钮 + 内高光 + 矢量双箭头
f10–14 预备回拉 1.5% 再甩出；甩动期间手柄微缩“被捏住”，按速度横向拉伸到 1.18，杆与手柄做方向性运动模糊，停下归零
补导出 BEFORE_AFTER_SLIDER_SCRUB_DURATION = 150（110f 动作 + 40f 静止）
issuesEn: The before layer was a full greyscale + grey wash, reading as a disabled screenshot rather than a believable unprocessed state
BEFORE/AFTER labels were grey placeholder bars that were not clipped by the divider and sat on top of cards
A 6px solid white bar with a heavy dark glow and a handle with a 3px grey border and CSS triangles looked like a wireframe
The fling started abruptly with no anticipation; the handle only stretched in X with no sense of speed
changesEn: Before is now slightly defocused (1.6px), desaturated, low-contrast with a warm haze, same layout and framing, so the difference is credible
Real Before / After pills sit in the empty top-bar space, each living in its own layer so the divider reveals them
Divider is a 2px white line with hairline edge and soft shadow plus a 24px contact shade; handle is a gradient white knob with inner highlight and vector chevrons
4f anticipation pull-back before the fling; the handle compresses while grabbed, stretches up to 1.18 by velocity, and bar + handle get directional motion blur that drops to zero at rest
